title: Noah's Ark in a Warming World: Climate Change, Biodiversity Loss and Public Adaptation Costs in the United States
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Climate change poses a growing threat to biodiversity, but the welfare consequences of these changes are not well understood. Here we analyze data on the US Endangered Species Act and project increases in species listing and spending due to climate change. We show that higher endangerment is strongly associated with the probability of listing but also find a large bias toward vertebrate species for both listing and spending. Unmitigated warming would cause the listing of an additional 690 species and committed spending of $21 billion by 2100. Several thousand more species would be critically imperiled by climate change but remain unlisted. Finally, we compare ESA spending with estimates of willingness to pay for conservation of 36 listed species. Aggregate WTP is larger than ESA spending for the vast majority of species even using conservative assumptions and typically one to two orders of magnitude larger than direct ESA spending using less restrictive assumptions.
abstract_zh: 气候变化对生物多样性构成日益严重的威胁，但这些变化的福利后果尚未得到充分理解。本文分析了美国《濒危物种法》（ESA）的数据，并预测了气候变化导致的物种列名数量和支出的增加。我们发现，物种的濒危程度与其被列名的概率密切相关，但同时也发现，无论是列名还是支出，都明显偏向脊椎动物物种。若不减缓变暖，到2100年将新增690个物种被列名，承诺支出达210亿美元。另有数千个物种将因气候变化而濒临严重灭绝，但仍未被列名。最后，我们将《濒危物种法》的支出与对36个已列名物种进行保护的支付意愿（WTP）估计值进行了比较。在绝大多数物种上，即使采用保守假设，总支付意愿也高于《濒危物种法》的支出；而采用较宽松的假设时，总支付意愿通常比直接的《濒危物种法》支出高出一到两个数量级。

Understanding the Improbable: A Survey of Fat Tails in Environmental Economics
abstract: We survey the growing literature on fat-tailed distributions in environmental economics. We then examine the theoretical and statistical properties of such distributions, focusing especially on when these properties are likely to arise in environmental problems. We find that a number of variables are fat tailed in environmental economics, including the climate sensitivity, natural disaster impacts, spread of infectious diseases, and stated willingness to pay. We argue that different fat-tailed distributions arise from common pathways. Finally, we review the literature on the policy implications of fat-tailed distributions and controversies over their interpretation. We conclude that the literature has made great strides in demonstrating when fat tails matter for optimal environmental policy. Yet, much is less well understood, including how alternative policies affect fat-tailed distributions, the optimal policy in a computational economy with many fat-tailed problems, and how to account for imprecision in empirical tests for fat tails.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了环境经济学中关于厚尾分布的不断增长的文献。随后，我们考察了此类分布的理论和统计性质，尤其关注这些性质何时可能出现于环境问题之中。我们发现，环境经济学中有若干变量呈厚尾分布，包括气候敏感性、自然灾害影响、传染病传播以及陈述的支付意愿。我们认为，不同的厚尾分布源于共同的成因路径。最后，我们回顾了关于厚尾分布的政策含义，以及对其解释存在争议的文献。我们的结论是，该文献在说明厚尾在何时对最优环境政策至关重要方面取得了长足进展。然而，仍有许多问题尚未被充分理解，包括替代政策如何影响厚尾分布、在存在多个厚尾问题的计算经济中的最优政策，以及如何在厚尾实证检验中考虑不精确性。

title: Private Benefits of Conservation and Procurement Auction Performance
Rethinking Aid Allocation: Analysis of Official Development Spending on Modern Pollution Reduction
abstract: Background: Modern pollution – pollution attributable to industrialization and urbanization – is responsible for nearly 6 million deaths per year, more than all the deaths from HIV, malaria, and tuberculosis combined; yet it receives comparatively little attention in the international development agenda [1]. Objective/Methods: This study attempts to highlight the funding disparity between select key threats to global health by quantifying the levels of international official development aid (ODA) allocated to reducing pollution’s negative impact on human health using a new metric – dollars spent per death caused by health threat. Findings: Using only reported ODA spending for 2016, we calculate an average investment of $14/death for modern pollution, compared with $1,250/death for malaria, $190/death for tuberculosis, and $165/death for HIV/AIDS. Conclusions: Although there are substantive limitations to this analysis, results are sufficient to galvanize action to better monitor and track investments in modern pollution reduction. Donor countries have failed to respond to this urgent public health crisis. Given the severity of its public health burden, there is a critical need for funding to be allocated specifically to pollution reduction.
abstract_zh: 背景：现代污染——由工业化和城市化引起的污染——每年导致近600万人死亡，超过艾滋病毒、疟疾和结核病导致的死亡人数总和；然而，它在国际发展议程中受到的关注相对较少[1]。目标/方法：本研究通过引入一种新的度量指标——每个健康威胁所致死亡所对应的花费（美元/死亡），量化用于减少污染对人类健康负面影响的国际官方发展援助（ODA）水平，以此突出关键全球健康威胁之间的资金分配不均。结果：仅使用2016年报告的官方发展援助支出数据，我们计算出现代污染的平均投入为每例死亡14美元，而疟疾为每例死亡1250美元，结核病为每例死亡190美元，艾滋病毒/艾滋病为每例死亡165美元。结论：尽管这项分析存在诸多局限，但其结果足以推动行动，以更好地监测和追踪减少现代污染的投资。捐助国未能对这一紧迫的公共卫生危机作出回应。鉴于其严重的公共卫生负担，迫切需要将资金专门用于减少污染。

title: District Subdivision and the Location of Smallholder Forest Conversion in Sumatra
abstract: A unique GIS data set from Indonesia that distinguishes smallholder and plantation operations is used to test the impact of district subdivision, which enhances local control of natural-resource revenues, on the location of smallholder forest conversion. Nonparametric analyses show that in subdivided districts, smallholders convert forests on steeper land that is farther from the nearest road and deeper into the forest. Smallholders are also less responsive to forest protection in subdivided districts. District subdivision imposes external costs of $1,629 to $4,941 per hectare due to increased carbon emissions associated with smallholder conversion deeper into the forest. (JEL C14, Q15)
abstract_zh: 本文利用印度尼西亚一套独特的GIS数据集，该数据集区分了小农户经营与种植园经营，用以检验县级分拆（district subdivision）的影响。县级分拆增强了地方对自然资源收入的控制权，我们考察其对小农户森林转换地点的影响。非参数分析表明，在经过分拆的县中，小农户转换的森林位于坡度更陡、距离最近道路更远、深入森林内部更深的土地上。在经过分拆的县中，小农户对森林保护政策的反应也更弱。由于小农户向森林深处转换导致碳排放增加，县级分拆每公顷施加了1629至4941美元的外部成本。（JEL C14, Q15）

title: Information Access, Conservation Practice Choice, and Rent Seeking in Conservation Procurement Auctions: Evidence from a Laboratory Experiment
abstract: Existing research emphasizes the sensitivity of conservation auction performance and bidder behavior to auction design choices, as these auctions are not incentive compatible, meaning rent seeking must be controlled. Procuring agencies must decide how to provide bidders with information about the environmental quality of different conservation practices to manage the trade‐off between an increased probability of selecting the optimal practice and increased rent‐seeking behavior associated with this information. We use an induced‐value laboratory experiment to explore how access to quality information and variation in the bid‐submission protocol can best be combined to improve auction performance. We find that the auction performs best when a bid‐menu format, in which participants submit bids for all their practices, is combined with information about the environmental quality rank of available conservation practices.
abstract_zh: 现有研究强调，保护性拍卖的绩效和投标人行为对拍卖设计的选择十分敏感，因为此类拍卖并非激励相容的，这意味着必须控制寻租行为。采购机构必须决定如何向投标人提供有关不同保护措施环境质量的信息，以权衡选中最优措施的概率提高与因信息而增加的寻租行为之间的取舍。我们利用诱导价值的实验室实验，探讨如何将质量信息的获取与投标提交方式的变化相结合，以最好地改善拍卖绩效。我们发现，当采用“投标菜单”形式（参与者为其所有措施提交投标）并结合可用保护措施环境质量排名的信息时，拍卖表现最佳。

title: Modeling the Impacts of Climate Change on Ecosystem Services
venue: Natural Capital: Theory and Practice of Mapping Ecosystem Services
abstract: This chapter uses several ecosystem service evaluation models and a biodiversity model to assess the potential impacts of climate change on irrigation demand, carbon storage, and biodiversity in the Willamette Basin of Oregon in the western United States. The three case studies investigated demonstrate the importance of making even preliminary estimates of potential climate impacts on ecosystem services. The land-use scenario that yields the lowest impact score is the one which provides the greatest potential for adaptation to climate change, which in the present study was generally the conservation scenario.
abstract_zh: 本章运用若干生态系统服务评估模型和一个生物多样性模型，评估气候变化对美国西部俄勒冈州威拉米特流域（Willamette Basin）灌溉需求、碳储存和生物多样性的潜在影响。所考察的三个案例研究表明，即使是初步估计气候变化对生态系统服务的潜在影响也非常重要。影响得分最低的土地利用情景，是那个为适应气候变化提供最大潜力的情景，而在本研究中，该情景通常是保护情景。

title: Terrestrial Carbon Sequestration and Storage
venue: Natural Capital: Theory and Practice of Mapping Ecosystem Services
abstract: This chapter presents a methodology for estimating carbon sequestration and storage (i.e., change in storage over time) on a landscape and the social value of the sequestration process. It presents two approaches for estimating carbon sequestration and storage on a landscape. In the simpler tier 1 approach, carbon storage is a function of land use and land cover (LULC), and sequestration is given by the difference in storage at two points in time. Carbon sequestration is not accounted for in a parcel of land unless its LULC changes or it is subject to harvest of wood. In the more complex tier 2 model, carbon storage in a parcel of land is a function of its LULC, the age of its LULC, and its previous LULC. Carbon sequestration is accounted for even if LULC or land management does not change over time, such as when a forest accumulates carbon in its standing biomass due to tree growth. The chapter illustrates both of these approaches with examples from Tanzania and the United States, and also demonstrates a method for determining the economic value of sequestration using the social cost of carbon.
abstract_zh: 本章提出了一种估算景观尺度上碳固存和碳储存（即随时间变化的储存量变化）的方法，以及该固存过程的社会价值。本章提出了两种估算景观碳固存和碳储存的途径。在较为简单的第一层级（tier 1）方法中，碳储存是土地利用和土地覆被（LULC）的函数，而碳固存则由两个时点之间的储存量差值给出。除非地块的土地利用和土地覆被发生变化，或者其木材遭到采伐，否则该地块的碳固存不会被计入。在较为复杂的第二层级（tier 2）模型中，地块的碳储存是其土地利用和土地覆被、土地利用和土地覆被的年龄以及其先前土地利用和土地覆被的函数。即使土地利用或土地管理没有随时间发生变化，碳固存仍会被计入，例如森林因树木生长而在其地上生物量中积累碳的情形。本章以坦桑尼亚和美国的案例说明了这两种方法，并展示了如何利用社会碳成本确定固存的经济价值。

title: Explaining the Price of Voluntary Carbon Offsets
abstract: This paper identifies factors that explain the large variability in the price of voluntary carbon offsets. We estimate hedonic price functions using a variety of provider- and project-level characteristics as explanatory variables. We find that providers located in Europe sell offsets at prices that are approximately 30% higher than providers located in either North America or Australasia. Contrary to what one might expect, offset prices are generally higher, by roughly 20%, when projects are located in developing or least-developed nations. But this result does not hold for forestry-based projects. We find evidence that forestry-based offsets sell at lower prices, and the result is particularly strong when projects are located in developing or least-developed nations. Offsets that are certified under the Clean Development Mechanism or the Gold Standard, and therefore qualify for emission reductions under the Kyoto Protocol, sell at a premium of more than 30%; however, third-party certification from the Voluntary Carbon Standard, one of the popular certifiers, is associated with a price discount. Variables that have no effect on offset prices are the number of projects that a provider manages and a provider's status as for-profit or not-for-profit.
abstract_zh: 本文识别了解释自愿碳抵消价格巨大差异的因素。我们使用多种提供者和项目层面的特征作为解释变量，估计了享乐价格函数。我们发现，位于欧洲的提供者出售碳抵消的价格，比位于北美或澳大拉西亚的提供者高出约30%。与人们的一般预期相反，当项目位于发展中国家或最不发达国家时，碳抵消的价格通常高出约20%。但这一结果并不适用于以林业为基础的项目。我们发现，以林业为基础的碳抵消价格较低，并且当项目位于发展中国家或最不发达国家时，这一结果尤为明显。根据《清洁发展机制》或《黄金标准》认证、因而有资格获得《京都议定书》减排量的碳抵消，其售价溢价超过30%；然而，来自热门认证机构之一——自愿碳标准（VCS）的第三方认证，却与价格折扣相关。对碳抵消价格没有影响的变量包括提供者管理的项目数量，以及提供者是营利性还是非营利性机构。

title: Indigenous Lands, Protected Areas, and Slowing Climate Change
abstract: Recent climate talks in Copenhagen reaffirmed the crucial role of reducing emissions from deforestation and degradation (REDD). Creating and strengthening indigenous lands and other protected areas represents an effective, practical, and immediate REDD strategy that addresses both biodiversity and climate crises at once.
abstract_zh: 哥本哈根近期的气候谈判再次确认了减少毁林和森林退化所致排放（REDD）的关键作用。设立并加强原住民土地和其他保护区，是一种有效、务实且迅速的REDD战略，能够同时应对生物多样性危机和气候危机。

title: Projecting Global Land-Use Change and its Effect on Ecosystem Service Provision and Biodiversity with Simple Models
abstract: BACKGROUND: As the global human population grows and its consumption patterns change, additional land will be needed for living space and agricultural production. A critical question facing global society is how to meet growing human demands for living space, food, fuel, and other materials while sustaining ecosystem services and biodiversity [1]. METHODOLOGY/PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: We spatially allocate two scenarios of 2000 to 2015 global areal change in urban land and cropland at the grid cell-level and measure the impact of this change on the provision of ecosystem services and biodiversity. The models and techniques used to spatially allocate land-use/land-cover (LULC) change and evaluate its impact on ecosystems are relatively simple and transparent [2]. The difference in the magnitude and pattern of cropland expansion across the two scenarios engenders different tradeoffs among crop production, provision of species habitat, and other important ecosystem services such as biomass carbon storage. For example, in one scenario, 5.2 grams of carbon stored in biomass is released for every additional calorie of crop produced across the globe; under the other scenario this tradeoff rate is 13.7. By comparing scenarios and their impacts we can begin to identify the global pattern of cropland and irrigation development that is significant enough to meet future food needs but has less of an impact on ecosystem service and habitat provision. CONCLUSIONS/SIGNIFICANCE: Urban area and croplands will expand in the future to meet human needs for living space, livelihoods, and food. In order to jointly provide desired levels of urban land, food production, and ecosystem service and species habitat provision the global society will have to become much more strategic in its allocation of intensively managed land uses. Here we illustrate a method for quickly and transparently evaluating the performance of potential global futures.
abstract_zh: 背景：随着全球人口增长和消费模式的变化，居住空间、农业生产需要更多土地。全球社会面临的一个关键问题是，如何在满足日益增长的居住空间、粮食、燃料和其他物资需求的同时，维持生态系统服务和生物多样性[1]。方法/主要发现：我们在网格单元层面空间分配了2000年至2015年全球城市用地和耕地面积变化的两种情景，并衡量这一变化对生态系统服务和生物多样性供给的影响。用于空间分配土地利用/土地覆被（LULC）变化并评估其对生态系统影响的模型和技术相对简单且透明[2]。两种情景下耕地扩张的规模和格局存在差异，由此产生了作物生产、物种栖息地供给以及生物量碳储存等其他重要生态系统服务之间的不同权衡。例如，在一种情景下，全球每多生产一卡路里作物，就会释放5.2克储存在生物量中的碳；而在另一种情景下，这一权衡比率为13.7。通过比较情景及其影响，我们可以开始识别全球耕地和灌溉开发的格局：这种格局既足以满足未来的粮食需求，又对生态系统服务和栖息地供给的影响较小。结论/意义：未来城市用地和耕地将进一步扩张，以满足人类对居住空间、生计和粮食的需求。为了共同提供所需水平的城市用地、粮食生产以及生态系统服务和物种栖息地，全球社会必须在集约化管理的土地利用配置上更具战略性。本文展示了一种快速、透明地评估潜在全球未来情景表现的方法。
